title: Boost GPU Priority for Games
name: gpu-priority-boost
modal: This raises GPU and CPU scheduling priority for the Games multimedia profile.
description: Raises GPU and CPU priority for games in the Windows multimedia scheduler
deepDescription:
Windows schedules GPU time per profile. This maxes out the Games profile:

- GPU Priority → 8
- Priority → 6
- Scheduling Category → High

Revert restores the defaults.
